touches.text: Its web panel is the operator's to-do list: email, trouble tickets, open questions (the ones only the operator can answer). The list is live: items appear as they arrive and leave as they're answered or resolved.

Artifacts awaiting review are not on it. Artifact review is replaced: the intentions say what it should look like, and CC assesses each artifact against them as one of: it gets us closer (keep); it could get us closer with changes (change it); it points the wrong way and should be replaced; it points the wrong way and should be dropped; ask more questions in order to decide.
Machine: the operator inbox builds the to-do list from live state, storing nothing (the operator_inbox tool, 17.14).
operator_inbox: builds the operator's to-do list from live state, storing nothing (7.3.7). USERS: Operator.
Trouble Ticket: an error that needs a non-automated fixer (CC or Akien).
A diagnostic report, EXACTLY like the Trouble Tickets in the Number Five Crossbar Telephone Switch. It MUST include EVERYTHING needed to diagnose, isolate, and repair the trouble.
